PHARMACEUTICAL EQUIVALENTS:-

FDA considers drug products to be pharmaceutical equivalents if they meet these criterion:

SAME
  • Active ingredients
  • Dosage form
  • Route of administration
  • Strength/Concentration
DIFFERENT
  • Shape
  • Labeling
  • Release mechanism
  • Scoring configuration
  • Excipient
